31: ### 3. Sort Game Timer & Penalty Scaling
32: - The Sort Game time limit starts at 15 seconds at Level 8, decreasing by 1 second every 3 levels:
33:   - Time limit = `Math.max(8, 15 - Math.floor((state.level - 8) / 3))` seconds.
34:   - At Level 8: **15 seconds**.
35:   - At Level 14: **13 seconds**.
36:   - At Level 20: **11 seconds**.
37:   - At Level 29+: Caps at **8 seconds** (minimum).
38: - The penalty for incorrect choices scales:
39:   - Level 8-14: Deduct **1 second**.
40:   - Level 15-29: Deduct **2 seconds**.
41:   - Level 30+: Deduct **3 seconds**.
42: - Updated `loseSortGame()` to **clear rewards visual block** so that players don't see "+60 Coins" and "+25 EXP" on failure screen.
